verdict.rationale: LM Studio's download page offers the headless llmster daemon, and a hands-on user reports a simple Windows install with no Python environment or build step, so prebuilt installation is evidenced. The pack never documents installers, package formats or package-manager channels per OS, and one older community report complains of no proper Linux support. Missing for 10: first-party docs listing prebuilt installers/packages per OS (Windows/macOS/Linux), package-manager distribution (e.g., brew/apt/winget), and explicit install instructions for llmster binaries.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: llmster is LM Studio's headless daemon for servers, cloud instances, and CI.
